g.text: CampusClaw Plan Mode - Complete Target Class View
At most one interaction across both kinds.
Current execution and plan identity are
rechecked under database locks before claim.
No metadata fields, tool descriptions or
schemas change when plan mode changes.
Green: existing structure Amber: existing, extended
Blue: new target-only class Blue connectors: target-only relations
Controllers, services, factories, repositories: Spring singletons
Execution package and tools: one instance per execution
